children.game_version: A call-and-response game where children mimic the triple-step and kick patterns.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the 8-count footwork using heel and toe taps while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Hold onto a stable chair for balance while practicing the triple-step and kick rhythm.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo significantly and limit the height of kicks.

movement_profile.footwork: Stationary 8-count basic; variations include triple-step, kick, triple-step, kick; triple-step, kick, step-stomp, run-run; and triple-step, kick, double kick.

signature_moves.description: Also known as over the tops.
signature_moves.name: Inside crosses

signature_moves.description: A rhythmic variation used in the dance.
signature_moves.name: Fall off the logs

music_profile.sound_description: Music is typically up-tempo swing, rock and roll, and jump blues, characterized by a driving, rhythmic quality that supports rapid, percussive footwork.

teaching.level_notes: Requires high stamina and rhythmic precision due to the rapid, stationary footwork.
